data.body:
Plan review 2026-10-18 returned BLOCK on one move: the plan flips `resolve` to the `argv_tracker_root` adapter but never says that `resolve_cli` must change signature to accept the third argument. Confirmed on origin/main b97d414b8e2:

- `src/rebar/_cli/_execute.py:122`: `argv_tracker_root` calls `fn(rest, tracker, None)` (3 args).
- `src/rebar/_engine_support/lookups.py:94`: `def resolve_cli(argv: list[str], tracker: str) -> int` (2 args).
- `src/rebar/_engine_support/lookups.py:110,120`: `format_cli(argv, tracker, repo_root)` already uses `_display_mode(repo_root)`, which is why `resolve` needs the root to host `--display`.
- The only reference to `resolve_cli` outside its definition is the handler string at `_registry.py:211`, so the signature change has exactly one call site.

Description amended: Approach step (2) now states the signature change `(argv, tracker)` -> `(argv, tracker, repo_root: str | None)`; Testing names the end-to-end dispatcher check (`main(["resolve", <id>, "--display=alias"])` and `main(["resolve", <id>])` both exit 0; a `TypeError` is the defect it catches); a new AC pins the signature, the adapter, and the dispatch test. The 11 advisory findings are left to the implementer.
